## Introduction to Bengaluru FC Cups
Bengaluru FC has been making waves in the football scene with their recent cup wins. According to [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bengaluru_FC), the club won the Durand Cup in the 2022/23 season, a notable achievement in their history. Additionally, [Transfermarkt](https://www.transfermarkt.us/bengaluru-fc/erfolge/verein/41030) confirms this win, highlighting the club's success in the 2022/23 season.

The club's achievements do not stop there. As reported by [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bengaluru_FC), Bengaluru FC has also won two Federation Cups, one in 2015 and another in 2017. This demonstrates the team's consistency and dedication to performing well in various competitions. Furthermore, [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Bengaluru_FC_records_and_statistics) provides a comprehensive list of the club's records and statistics, showcasing their impressive track record in Indian football.

Bengaluru FC's success is not limited to domestic cups. As mentioned in an article by [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/41257024), the team traveled to North Korea to play against Pyongyang's 4.25 SC in the AFC Cup, a significant event in the club's history. This highlights the team's ability to compete at an international level and their commitment to representing Indian football on the global stage. With players like Sunil Chhetri, who has been in the news recently due to the club's decision to put player salaries on hold, as reported by [Hindustantimes](https://www.hindustantimes.com/sports/football/sunil-chhetri-and-other-bengaluru-fc-players-salaries-put-on-hold-after-isl-club-takes-difficult-decision-101754357254065.html), the team is sure to continue making headlines in the football world.

The club's recent performances and achievements have been well-documented by various sources, including [Soccerway](https://www.soccerway.com/team/bengaluru-fc/tCnsmWKr) and [Goal](https://www.goal.com/en-in/team/bengaluru-fc/table/12ksg0e6d70senzilsic40fzl), which provide detailed statistics and standings for the team. With their impressive record and dedication to the sport, Bengaluru FC is a team to watch in the world of football. As the team continues to strive for excellence, their fans can expect exciting matches and notable achievements in the future.

## Recent Achievements of Bengaluru FC
Bengaluru FC has been making waves in the football scene with their recent achievements. According to [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bengaluru_FC), the club has won two I-League titles and one Indian Super League title, showcasing their dominance in the sport. Additionally, they have also won a Super Cup in 2018, as reported by [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bengaluru_FC) and [Transfermarkt](https://www.transfermarkt.us/bengaluru-fc/erfolge/verein/41030).

The club's impressive record is further highlighted by their wins in the Federation Cups, with two titles in 2015 and 2017, as mentioned in [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bengaluru_FC). Moreover, [Transfermarkt](https://www.transfermarkt.us/bengaluru-fc/erfolge/verein/41030) reports that Bengaluru FC won the Durand Cup in the 2022-2023 season, demonstrating their continued success in recent years. These achievements are a testament to the team's hard work and dedication to the sport.

Bengaluru FC's achievements are not limited to their titles and wins. The club has also been making headlines with their player salaries, as reported by [Hindustantimes](https://www.hindustantimes.com/sports/football/sunil-chhetri-and-other-bengaluru-fc-players-salaries-put-on-hold-after-isl-club-takes-difficult-decision-101754357254065.html). The club's decision to put player salaries on hold has been a topic of discussion, with players like Sunil Chhetri being affected. Furthermore, the club's participation in international tournaments, such as the AFC Cup, has also been notable, with [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/41257024) reporting on their match against Pyongyang's 4.25 SC in North Korea.

The club's recent performances and achievements can be attributed to the efforts of their players and staff. With their impressive record and continued success, Bengaluru FC is a team to watch in the football scene. As reported by [Soccerway](https://www.soccerway.com/team/bengaluru-fc/tCnsmWKr), the club provides updates on their stats, results, fixtures, and transfers, keeping fans informed about their progress. Overall, Bengaluru FC's recent achievements are a reflection of their dedication to the sport and their commitment to excellence.
